meta.name: Ganesh Yadava
meta.tagline: Bridging strategy, data, and delivery — from requirements to results.
meta.availabilityNote: Open to full-time roles in business analysis, functional consulting, or analytics — Mumbai, Ireland, or remote.

paragraphs: I'm an analytically driven professional with a background in software engineering and a postgraduate specialisation in business analytics. I translate between two worlds — the technical and the strategic — helping organisations move faster and decide smarter.

After two years delivering platform modernisation at Jio Platforms, one of India's largest telecom groups, I pursued an MSc in Business Analytics at NUI Galway — sharpening my ability to model decisions, design KPI frameworks, and lead data-informed consulting engagements.
Today I lead functional and analytical work on a live athlete performance platform, while taking on consulting projects that span operational analysis, process improvement, and digital strategy.

experience.headline: Leading functional delivery for a live athlete performance analytics platform.
bullets: Lead requirements gathering sessions with cross-functional stakeholders, translating business needs into structured technical deliverables.
Manage end-to-end project lifecycle using Agile methodology — planning, prototyping, testing, deployment, and documentation.
Produce functional specifications, process documentation, and project tracking artefacts.
Drive iterative product improvements through analytics-led decision-making.

experience.headline: Operational analysis and process improvement for a private business client.
bullets: Conducted end-to-end operational analysis to identify process bottlenecks affecting customer flow, service conversion, and revenue.
Delivered a structured business improvement report with KPI-backed recommendations.
Proposed data-driven digital customer retention strategies based on customer behaviour and service demand analysis.

experience.headline: Cross-functional delivery at enterprise scale — one of India's largest technology platforms.
bullets: Collaborated with product and engineering teams to gather and document functional requirements during large-scale platform modernisation.
Conducted application log analysis and performance diagnostics — delivering a 30% improvement in load performance and a 25% reduction in crash rates.
Acted as a functional bridge between stakeholder requirements and engineering implementation across Agile delivery cycles.
Contributed to a 15% improvement in user satisfaction scores through structured issue tracking and process documentation.
Built stakeholder communication and requirement-management skills through active participation in product enhancement discussions.
